sections.name: architecture
sections.value: Doctrine: .agents-skills-port/pij-team/TENETS.md. Stack: crates/core (vocabulary, ports), crates/store (sqlite; tables projects/streams/dispatches/batons/baton_leases/prime_designation/seat_roles already exist), crates/daemon (http composition root, EventBus, delivery), crates/cli (pij-rs verbs, v2 JSON envelopes {ok,command,v:2,data|error}), .pi/extensions/pij (legacy shim; generation-routing.ts RS_ROUTE_TABLE decides rs vs legacy), skills/pij (route modules). FROZEN SEAMS: (a) ONE spine writer — `EventBus::publish` is the only path that inserts spine_events; ReportService and Registry receive the bus (or a Spine impl that IS the bus); direct INSERTs outside crates/store/src/spine.rs are forbidden and tested. (b) Every new route is additive under /v1/, bearer-authed like /v1/register, request/response pinned in assets/contracts/governance-routes.json (u0, PM-owned) and consumed by tests, never restated. (c) Event kinds for governance reuse the legacy names (project.*, stream.*, fence.*, dispatch.*, ack, canary.*, attest.*, task.set, baton.*, prime.*, decision.*) with `payload` a JSON string, additive fields only; frame shape StreamFrame::Event unchanged. (d) Ownership: role/close/answer are permitted for the seat itself or its recorded `parent`; refusals decodable (E-RS-OWNERSHIP). (e) Anomalies are DERIVED at read time from rs rows + spine, never stored. (f) The legacy shim never writes legacy for a verb in the skill table: serve (route to rs) or refuse `E-RS-UNPORTED <verb>` — enforced by a test that reads skills/pij/README.md's verb table.

value.rationale: Six units in four waves with disjoint fences: u1 store/events, u2 identity, u3 governance tables/routes, u4 anomalies/decisions, u5 lifecycle, u6 TS shim + skills + docs. u2 and u3 share crates/cli main.rs verb registration — PM assigns u2 the `role` verb file and u3 the governance verb files; verb wiring lines merged by PM. Wave 0 contract is PM-owned.

value.name: contract: governance routes + events
value.responsibility: Canonical JSON for every new route's request/response, every event kind's payload, the decision row, the anomaly row, and the refusal envelopes (E-RS-UNPORTED, E-RS-OWNERSHIP).
value.interface: governance-routes.json + governance-events.json, consumed by u1–u6 tests.
value.test_strategy: None of its own; every unit pins against it.
value.note: PM writes before any spawn; changes after wave 1 need prime ack (seam-change window).

value.name: one spine writer + stamped descriptor events
value.responsibility: Route ReportService and Registry::put/tombstone through EventBus; stamp at; seat.put payload = descriptor; grep-test forbidding direct INSERT.
value.interface: No wire change; events now arrive live.
value.test_strategy: RED: reproduce chainglass's control as an integration test (two subscribers, adopt + report while open) failing on main; GREEN after. Unit: no-direct-INSERT source scan.

value.name: role: writer, verb, row join
value.paths: crates/daemon/src/http/{types,identity,report}.rs (role fields); crates/daemon/src/registration.rs (role on register/adopt); crates/store/src/orchestration.rs (assign_role callers) ; crates/cli/src/role.rs (new) + CLI wiring line
value.responsibility: --role on register/adopt; POST /v1/role; seat_roles joined into /v1/seats.role and StateCard.role; ownership self-or-parent.
value.interface: /v1/role {seat, role} → {seat, role, assigned_by}; seats row `role` populated.
value.test_strategy: RED: /v1/seats role null after adopt --role; ownership refusal test; golden list-envelope updated.

value.name: governance records: project/stream/fence/dispatch/ack/canary/attest/task/node/baton/prime
value.paths: crates/store/src/{orchestration,dispatch,governance}.rs; crates/store/migrations/0014_*.sql; crates/daemon/src/http/governance.rs (new, incl spine append/events/render); crates/cli/src/governance.rs (new, incl spine verbs); PM owns Route/CLI/module wiring.
value.responsibility: Additive routes and verbs over the existing tables; dispatch carries a packet pointer with a three-state receipt (queued/delivered/acked) riding /v1/send; node show renders the tree from rs rows.
value.test_strategy: Store tests per table; http tests per route with the contract fixtures; CLI golden envelopes; one end-to-end sequence test.

value.name: anomalies view, report verify, decisions
value.paths: crates/store/migrations/0015_*.sql; crates/store/src/decisions.rs (new); crates/daemon/src/http/{anomalies,decisions}.rs (new); crates/core/src/{anomalies,decisions}.rs (new); crates/daemon/src/http/report.rs (verify/question leaves); crates/cli/src/{anomalies,decisions}.rs (new); PM owns shared wiring.
value.responsibility: Derive anomaly rows (status-stale, unverified-done, open-question, unacked-dispatch, dead-seat) from rs data; `report verify`; decision rows from `report question`, `pij-rs decisions`, `pij-rs answer` delivering to the asker via /v1/send.
value.test_strategy: Fixture spines → expected anomaly rows (goldens); decision lifecycle test; relay-line text parity test against legacy strings.

value.name: lifecycle: close + reap
value.paths: crates/daemon/src/http/lifecycle.rs (new) + Route lines; crates/daemon/src/reaper.rs (new); crates/cli/src/lifecycle.rs (new) + wiring; crates/harnesses/src/proc.rs and focused liveness tests (prime-approved failed-ps UNKNOWN fix)
value.responsibility: `close <id>` owner-only tombstone; `reap [--dry-run]` over proc{pid,proc_start}+pane using existing liveness ports; refuses recycled pid; counts before/after.
value.test_strategy: Fake liveness fixtures incl. plan 095 recycled-pid case; dry-run equals run minus writes; ownership refusal.

value.name: re-point: shim serve-or-refuse, skills, API doc
value.responsibility: RS_ROUTE_TABLE covers every verb in the skill table (serve or E-RS-UNPORTED); enforcement test; skills cite rs verbs; API doc with pinned samples; chainglass confirmation.
value.test_strategy: Enforcement test reads skills/pij/README.md verb table; vitest for routing; skill structural gates (`just` skill checks).

value.note: Each coder branches off 139-rs-governance-port into ../fs3-rs-governance-port-<unit>. Coders never touch main, its node_modules, the live daemon (port 7461) or global links; pre-merge proofs run on an ISOLATED daemon built from the coder's worktree (--state-dir, PIJ_RS_ADDR). PM composes on the plan branch; PRIME merges to main, rebuilds, bounces.

value.steps: 1) Merge u1; cargo gates; chainglass control RED→GREEN on an isolated daemon. 2) Merge u2 and u3; resolve CLI wiring lines; cargo gates; golden envelopes. 3) Merge u4 and u5; cargo gates. 4) Merge u6; vitest routing + typecheck + skill gates via main's binaries read-only. 5) Full `harness checks` on the composed branch. 6) Isolated-daemon end-to-end: AC4 sequence + AC5/AC6/AC7 proofs, seqs into assets/live-proof.md. 7) Reviewer (opus 5, omp, high). 8) Hand prime the composed sha; prime merges, rebuilds, bounces, runs AC1/AC2 on production, asks antelope for AC3/AC9 confirmation.
value.integration_proof: On one isolated daemon: adopt --role, project→stream→fence→dispatch→ack→canary→attest→task→node show; report question → parent sees decision → answer lands at the asker; report done → verify clears unverified-done; close a seat; reap --dry-run; two /v1/events subscribers saw every row live with at≠0. Then the same commands typed as legacy `pij …` serve from rs.

value.when: after composition, before handing prime the sha
value.inputs: plan.dd.md + this guide + branch diff; priority: (1) exactly one spine writer and the grep test proves it; (2) ownership refusals are real (a third seat cannot set role/close/answer); (3) anomalies computed, not stored, and relay lines match legacy text; (4) the shim enforcement test actually reads the skill table (mutate-the-guard: add a fake verb to the table and watch it fail); (5) no delivery-semantics drift from #373/#374.

value.text: Making the bus the only writer changes registration latency/ordering (publish awaits store append). Retire: u1 keeps append-then-broadcast; registration tests assert seq monotonic per seat.
Anomaly relay-line text drifts from what supervisors/PA scripts grep. Retire: parity test against the legacy strings captured in assets/inputs.

Refusing unported verbs breaks a live ritual that was silently working on legacy (honesty-removes-a-load-bearing-fallback). Retire: u6 lists every verb that changes from silent-legacy to refusal in live-proof; prime broadcasts to primes before deploy.
u2/u3/u4/u5 all add CLI verbs in crates/cli/src/main.rs. Retire: one new file per unit; PM owns the wiring lines at compose.

Astra on omp depends on two local dist/cli.js patches; an omp self-update swaps in a Bun binary and breaks them (2026-09-06). Retire: coders never run `omp update`; a 400 unsupported_api_for_model or 'does not support thinking' is that — report to prime.
